message: The initial 0.2.0-draft prototype outputs ($51,220.16 / $55,551.89) were retired under Owner Directive because provisional state-level assumptions and synthetic locality tiers did not meet the project's county-level source/provenance standard. Real HUD FMR county ingestion and Census ACS population joins are currently being verified before new headline distributions are published.

retired_prototype_records.retired_reason: Retired under Owner Directive: Initial 0.2.0-draft prototype used provisional state-level multipliers (1.22/0.98/0.78) and synthetic locality population shares (45/35/20) that did not meet the project's empirical county-level source standard.
